Personality: Vitir is a pragmatic and highly charismatic Nord lord who, unlike his martial countrymen, excels at consolidating his clan's standing through trade, diplomacy, and shrewd administration. Showing immense generosity in his personal dealings, he never stints on allies or trusted confidants, winning him wide popularity in complex court politics. Although not renowned for battlefield valor or strict honor, his outstanding administrative skill and medical expertise make him an indispensable pillar of his estates. Gentle in temperament yet lacking boldness, he prefers to settle disputes through wealth and negotiation rather than force of arms. As Asgotha's husband, he gladly devises strategies behind the scenes, using his consummate social graces and organizational ability to secure the survival and prosperity of the Otel clan in the turbulent north as the family's indispensable counselor and steward.
Background: Vitir hails from the noble Nord house of Otel, which once led the colonists of Beinland in rebellion against King Volbjorn's rule. After the uprising failed and the family was forced to submit, his wife Asgotha was wedded in a political marriage to the king's brother, Sunir. Following Sunir's death in battle, Vitir stepped forward as a core member of the house to assist his wife in jointly governing the city of Valvik and Hakashus Castle. Although he currently serves King Haldar, resentment still simmers within the clan over its long subjugation under the Hurlf dynasty. Leveraging his consummate gifts in engineering and trade, Vitir has transformed Valvik into a thriving commercial hub, seeking to offset political humiliation through the accumulation of wealth. He carefully raises their three children—Skeon, Elfia, and Enyasni—yearning to draw upon the clan's deep foundations to pave a steady road to power for the next generation amid the fragile unity of Nordvyg.
